sceneConcept: A lean thirty-two-year-old Chinese logistics consultant stands alone against a transparent background. Short side-parted black hair, brown eyes and a carefully neutral expression make him look like a polished local businessman rather than an overt gangster. He wears a neat but mid-priced unstructured slate-blue blazer open over a light grey open-collar shirt, straight black trousers, a simple belt and polished brown shoes. Both hands rest in his trouser pockets while he pauses to assess the viewer. Opaque layers fully cover the left chest. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the presentation restrained. Visual refresh: a tailored bomber jacket over port utility streetwear with the hidden eagle mark retained.
